jobs.occupation: Senior Reliability Engineer, Equipment Maintenance & Calibration
jobs.description:
Location: _Søborg, Denmark. Please note that AGC Biologics does not offer relocation assistance. Applicants must already reside in Denmark or the Greater Malmö area in Sweden.

_Are you the type of person who enjoys understanding how things work, questioning assumptions, and solving complex technical problems?

We are looking for a Sr Reliability Engineer to help shape the future of our maintenance, calibration and asset management programs. This is not a traditional maintenance role. Instead, you will focus on understanding equipment risks, analysing failure mechanisms, evaluating maintenance effectiveness, and developing data-driven maintenance and calibration strategies.

Some days you will be deep in equipment data, conducting component-level risk assessments and reliability analyses. Other days you will be presenting your recommendations, challenging established practices, and facilitating discussions with stakeholders across Manufacturing, Quality, Compliance, Engineering, and Maintenance.

Whether you are an experienced reliability professional or an exceptional early-career engineer with strong analytical abilities, we are interested in hearing from you.

**What You'll Be Doing

**Risk Assessment & Reliability Engineering

• Perform detailed equipment, instrument and component-level risk assessments.

• Identify failure modes and evaluate their impact on safety, compliance, reliability, and operational performance.

• Conduct FMECA, criticality assessments, root cause analyses, and other reliability studies.

• Support a risk-based approach to maintenance decision-making.

Maintenance & Calibration Strategy Development

• Evaluate existing maintenance and calibration programs and challenge activities that do not deliver value.

• Redesign and optimize preventive, predictive, corrective, and condition-based maintenance and calibration strategies.

• Build maintenance and calibration programs based on risk, data, and equipment criticality.

• Develop practical recommendations that improve equipment reliability while optimizing resource utilization.

Data Analysis & Continuous Improvement

• Analyse maintenance and calibration history, failure data, asset performance trends, and reliability metrics.

• Identify patterns, recurring issues, and improvement opportunities.

• Convert complex data into actionable recommendations.

• Support the development of KPIs and performance monitoring tools.

• Support digitalization initiatives that improve data visibility, decision-making, and maintenance effectiveness across the organization.

• Develop and maintain reporting and analytical tools, including Power BI dashboards and visualizations, to support reliability, risk, and maintenance strategy decisions.

Stakeholder Collaboration

• Work closely with Manufacturing, Quality, Compliance, Engineering, and Maintenance teams.

• Facilitate discussions where priorities may differ and help build alignment around technical decisions.

• Present findings and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

• Support internal and external audits by presenting maintenance strategies, risk assessments, and technical rationales, and by clearly communicating decisions to auditors and regulatory stakeholders.

• Act as a subject matter expert during audits and inspections, presenting risk assessments, maintenance strategies, and technical justifications to auditors, Quality, and Compliance stakeholders.

**What We're Looking For

**We are less interested in the number of years on your CV and more interested in how you think.

**You Are Likely Someone Who

**

• Enjoys analysing complex technical problems.

• Is naturally curious and asks "why" before accepting a conclusion.

• Can work independently and stay focused on difficult problems.

• Is comfortable challenging established ways of working when supported by facts and data.

• Can communicate confidently with stakeholders at all levels of the organization.

• Is persistent, resilient, and comfortable navigating disagreement.

• Can balance technical rigor with practical business realities.

**Qualifications

**You may be an experienced engineer or a recent graduate.

**We'd Like To See

**

• Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Engineering, Reliability Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Production Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Data Analytics, or a related technical discipline.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.

• Interest in asset reliability, maintenance optimization, risk management, or data analysis.

• Ability to work with complex datasets and draw meaningful conclusions.

• Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, P&IDs, User Requirement Specifications, Technical Specifications, and equipment manufacturer manuals.

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

• Fluency in English.

Experience with the following is considered an advantage but is not required:

• FMECA

• FMEA

• RCM (Reliability Centred Maintenance)

• Root Cause Analysis

• Asset Criticality Assessments

• Reliability Engineering

• Maintenance Management Systems (CMMS)

• Manufacturing, pharmaceutical, biotech, food, chemical, or process industries

Who Will Thrive in This Role?

**This Role Is Likely a Great Fit If You

**

• Enjoy working independently and becoming an expert in a technical area.

• Like digging into data until you fully understand a problem.

• Are comfortable having difficult conversations when the facts support your position.

• Prefer solving root causes rather than treating symptoms.

• Enjoy building new solutions instead of simply maintaining existing processes.

• Enjoy understanding how equipment works by combining field observations with technical drawings, P&IDs, manuals, performance data, and engineering principles.

• Want to have a genuine impact on how maintenance and reliability decisions are made.

What We Offer

• A unique opportunity to shape and improve maintenance strategy across critical assets.

• Exposure to cross-functional decision-making and collaboration with senior stakeholders.

• Significant autonomy, ownership, and freedom to drive improvements.

• An environment that values analytical thinking, curiosity, and continuous improvement.

• Opportunities for professional growth regardless of your level of experience.

• A highly visible role with the opportunity to influence decisions, drive change, and provide informal leadership across the organization.

**Join our team

**We are eager to welcome a new colleague as soon as possible. Please submit your application no later than 30 November 2026. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, and we reserve the right to close the vacancy before the deadline if a suitable candidate is found.

Please apply exclusively through our recruitment system. Applications submitted through other channels will not be considered.

To support an inclusive and unbiased recruitment process, please do not include a photo in your CV. At AGC Biologics, we are committed to fair hiring practices and value diversity and inclusion throughout our recruitment process.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Sameer Ahmed, Senior Manager, Equipment Maintenance, at **sameer.ahmed@agc.com

**Please note that AGC Biologics does not offer relocation assistance. Applicants must already reside in Denmark or the Greater Malmö area in Sweden.

We look forward to receiving your application!

**Who We Are

**AGC Biologics is a global Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization with a strong presence in Denmark. From our Søborg site, we develop and manufacture life‑changing advanced biologics for some of the world’s most innovative pharmaceutical companies. Together with our team members across Europe, the U.S., and Japan, we deliver development and manufacturing of mammalian and microbial-based therapeutic proteins, plasmid DNA (pDNA), messenger RNA (mRNA), viral vectors, and genetically engineered cells therapies. Across our global network, we are united by one mission: To work side by side with our customers in order to improve patients’ lives by bringing new biopharmaceuticals to market.

Turn vulnerability data into actionable cyber risk intelligence

Cyber Defense is transforming how TDC Brands identifies, prioritises and manages cyber risk across one of Denmark's largest digital environments.

We are building a mature, risk-based Vulnerability Management capability spanning infrastructure, cloud, end-user devices, applications and third-party services.

To strengthen this capability, we are looking for a Vulnerability Intelligence & Analytics Manager who can turn complex vulnerability and asset data into trusted insights, meaningful reporting and measurable risk reduction.

You will be responsible for the data, analytics and platform foundation that enables Vulnerability Management across TDC Brands.

Your role

As Vulnerability Intelligence & Analytics Manager, you will take the lead on Vulnerability Management platforms, data, analytics and reporting within Cyber Defense.

Where our Senior Vulnerability Manager primarily drives the technical assessment and remediation discipline, you will ensure that we have the right data, tooling and intelligence to understand our exposure and measure how effectively risk is being reduced.

Together, the two roles form the core of our Vulnerability Management capability and will work closely together and provide mutual coverage when required.

You will work across Cyber Defense, infrastructure and application teams, technology partners and management to create transparency around vulnerabilities, remediation performance and cyber risk.

Key responsibilities

You will:

• Own and continuously develop Vulnerability Management platforms, reporting and analytics across TDC Brands

• Develop dashboards and reporting that provide clear visibility of vulnerabilities, exposure and remediation performance

• Define and maintain Vulnerability Management KPIs, KRIs, SLAs and other performance metrics

• Create operational, management and executive-level cyber risk reporting

• Integrate and correlate vulnerability, asset, threat and business-context data from multiple sources

• Monitor data quality and work with technology teams to improve asset coverage, accuracy and completeness

• Analyse trends, recurring vulnerabilities, risk concentrations and remediation effectiveness

• Develop and automate data flows, reporting processes and platform integrations

• Support governance processes including remediation follow-up, risk acceptance and exception management

• Work closely with the Senior Vulnerability Manager to continuously improve risk-based vulnerability prioritisation

• Support audit, compliance and regulatory reporting requirements

What we are looking for

You combine an understanding of cyber security with strong capabilities in analytics, platforms and data.

You are comfortable working with complex datasets but can also turn them into simple, credible insights that enable both technical teams and senior leaders to make better risk decisions.

We expect you to bring:

• 3–5+ years of relevant experience within cyber security, Vulnerability Management, security analytics, risk or a related discipline

• Experience working with vulnerability, security or technology data at enterprise scale

• Strong experience with Power BI, data modelling and dashboard development

• Experience defining and developing KPIs, KRIs and management reporting

• Understanding of Vulnerability Management concepts including CVEs, CVSS, remediation and risk-based prioritisation

• Experience integrating data from enterprise platforms such as Vulnerability Management tools, ServiceNow, CMDBs or security platforms

• Strong analytical skills and the ability to identify patterns, data-quality issues and meaningful trends

• Strong stakeholder management and the ability to communicate clearly with both technical specialists and senior management

Experience with technologies such as Power Query, SQL, KQL, APIs, Python or PowerShell will be an advantage.

Experience with Vulnerability Management platforms such as Rapid7, Microsoft Defender or similar, as well as knowledge of ITSM/CMDB is also valuable.

Familiarity with frameworks such as NIST CSF, CIS Controls or ISO 27001 is welcome but not required.

Why Cyber Defense at TDC Brands?

You will join a diverse Cyber Defense organisation of 13+ colleagues working across Vulnerability Management, Security Architecture, Security Operations and Identity & Access Management.

You will have the opportunity to:

• Shape the data and technology foundation of Vulnerability Management at TDC Brands

• Build transparency around cyber risk at enterprise scale

• Work with large and complex security and technology datasets

• Influence both operational improvements and senior management risk decisions

• Work closely with experienced Cyber Defense and technology specialists

• Develop your skills through professional training and certifications

• Be part of a team that helps secure national critical infrastructure

Application

The position is full-time with workplace at Teglholmsgade 1, Copenhagen or Sletvej 30, Aarhus, and we expect regular presence at one of our offices.

Desired start date is as soon as possible.

Candidates must be EU/EEA citizens and reside in Denmark.

Application: It is not necessary to attach a cover letter, but please include a brief introduction in your CV about why you are applying for this position. To ensure a fair and inclusive recruitment process, we kindly ask you to refrain from adding a photo to your CV. It is a condition of employment that your criminal record is approved by TDC Brands.

Application date: 12/11/2026

Contact person: Kenny Damgaard Outzen at kdni@tdcbrands.dk

Work location: Teglholmsgade 1, Copenhagen & Sletvej 30, Aarhus

About TDC Brands TDC Brands consists of a number of strong brands that together deliver innovative digital services within TV, broadband, network and telephony to private customers and businesses. YouSee, Telmore, Hiper and eesy serve Danes across age, gender and place of residence in the private market. In the business market, TDC Brands serves both small and large companies with TDC Erhverv and Relatel. TDC Brands currently employs around 3,000 people and has approximately 6 million private and business customer relationships. Read more about TDC Brands at tdcbrands.dk.

About TDC Brands

TDC Brands is home to YouSee, TDC Erhverv, Telmore, Hiper, eesy and Relatel — around 3,000 employees and roughly 6 million consumer and business customer relationships in Denmark. We are the commercial and service side of Danish telecom; TDC NET owns and runs the physical network.

We are putting AI to work across customer service, digital channels, sales and our own internal operations. Doing that in a company millions of Danes rely on means doing it carefully.

Why this role exists

AI governance fails in one of two ways. It becomes a review gate that slows everything down, or it becomes a document nobody reads. We want neither.

This role keeps governance close to the work. You’ll own the practical machinery — the use-case inventory, the risk assessments, the evaluation and testing — and you’ll sit inside the proof-of-concepts as they are built, not review them afterwards. It is a rare combination of skills, and a good place to build a career: governance people who can actually build are scarce, and getting scarcer.

What you’ll do

• Own the agent inventory. Maintain a live picture of every AI agent we run, and of the copilots, RAG applications and embedded model features around them — what each one does, what data and systems it can reach, what it is allowed to do without a human, who owns it, and where it sits against EU AI Act risk categories.

• Run the assessments. Work through risk, privacy and security reviews with Legal, Privacy and Security colleagues, and turn their requirements into something an engineering team can act on.

• Test what we build. Design and run evaluations: accuracy, hallucination, bias, prompt injection, tool misuse and failure behaviour. Build the test sets and keep them current as models and agents change.

• Help build the proof-of-concepts. Work hands-on alongside the AI Evangelist and delivery teams — preparing data, writing and refining prompts, wiring up APIs, measuring whether the thing actually works.

• Document it properly. Model cards, decision records and system documentation that stand up to an audit and are still readable by the people who have to use them.

• Watch the horizon. Track regulation, guidance and tooling as they evolve, and translate them into short, practical checklists rather than long policy documents.

Your first year

• A complete, trusted inventory across the six brands — agents and the AI applications around them — with risk classifications and ownership everyone agrees on.

• A working evaluation approach applied to at least two production or near-production systems.

• Assessment and documentation templates that teams reach for because they save time, not because they are mandatory.

• A reputation as the person engineers invite into a project early rather than call at the end.

What we’re looking for

• Around 4 years’ experience in data, AI, technology risk, compliance or a closely related field.

• Enough hands-on ability to be useful in a prototype: Python at a practical level — notebooks, scripts, calling APIs — and comfort with how LLM applications are put together. You do not need to be a software engineer.

• A working understanding of GDPR, and genuine interest in the EU AI Act and what it means in practice.

• Clear, structured writing. Much of this job is making complicated things legible to someone who has fifteen minutes.

• The confidence to ask an uncomfortable question in a room of senior people, and the judgement to know which questions are worth asking.

If you meet most of this and the rest is learnable, we’d still like to hear from you.

Also useful, not required

• Experience in a regulated industry — telecom, finance, health or public sector.

• Familiarity with evaluation tooling and frameworks for LLM applications.

• Experience with Azure AI, AWS or Google Cloud AI services.

• Exposure to ISO/IEC 42001, NIST AI RMF or similar management frameworks.

• Danish language skills — useful for stakeholder work, but not a requirement.

What you’ll get out of it

• Direct mentoring from senior AI and architecture colleagues, and close work with Legal, Privacy and Security.

• Visibility across six brands and both consumer and business markets — unusual breadth for an early-career role.

• A seat at the table while an enterprise AI practice is being built, rather than inheriting one already built.

Practical details

• Location: Teglholmsgade 1, Copenhagen. Hybrid, with four days a week on site.

• Team: You’ll join Data & AI, a team of around 40 people, working alongside the Senior AI Evangelist.

• Language: English is our main language of communication. Danish is an advantage.

How to apply

Send your CV and a short note - half a page is plenty - on one AI risk you think companies currently underestimate, and what you would do about it. No formal cover letter needed.

Questions before applying? Contact Sunanda Sengupta at sunse@tdcbrands.dk

Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis

About TDC Brands

TDC Brands is home to YouSee, TDC Erhverv, Telmore, Hiper, eesy and Relatel — around 3,000 employees and roughly 6 million consumer and business customer relationships in Denmark. We are the commercial and service side of Danish telecom; TDC NET owns and runs the physical network.

That shapes this role. The AI opportunity here is in customer experience, service operations, digital channels, sales and the work of our own employees — millions of interactions every month, across six brands and two very different markets.

Why this role exists

We have a data foundation in place and several AI initiatives already underway. What this role adds is continuity: someone to take promising ideas through to production safely, and to help teams across the business get comfortable using them.

The work is part advocate, part builder. Expect to spend your time fairly evenly between convincing, designing and prototyping.

What you’ll do

• Find the work that matters. Cut through the long list of possible AI use cases and identify the handful — across customer service, digital channels, sales, support and internal productivity — with real value behind them.

• Bring people with you. Workshops, demos, mentoring and straight answers to executives about what AI will and won’t do for them. Build confidence and capability across teams that don’t start out fluent in this.

• Build, not just advise. You’ll prototype yourself. A credible working demo moves this organisation faster than a deck, and you’ll produce both.

• Design for production. Enterprise-grade patterns for LLM applications, RAG, agent orchestration and the surrounding API, data and identity plumbing, across a multi-brand landscape.

• Set the guardrails. Define our Responsible AI approach in practical terms: evaluation, human oversight, data privacy, model risk, EU AI Act and GDPR alignment — as engineering standards, not a policy PDF.

• Make the path repeatable. Turn one-off successes into reusable patterns so the second and third team move faster than the first.

Your first year

• Three to five high-value use cases identified, prototyped and assessed on evidence rather than enthusiasm.

• At least one of them live in production, with monitoring, evaluation and a named owner.

• A Responsible AI standard that teams actually use, because it comes with tooling and reference implementations.

• Colleagues across business and technology who can tell you, accurately, where AI fits in their work and where it doesn’t.

What we’re looking for

• 10+ years in technology, with depth in AI/ML, data or solution architecture.

• Hands-on experience building with generative and agentic AI — LLMs, RAG, agent orchestration, evaluation — not only overseeing it.

• A track record of taking systems into production in a large or regulated organisation, and of designing for security, privacy and failure.

• The presence to lead a room: excellent communication and storytelling, and the judgement to tell a real use case from an expensive demo — and to explain that difference to both engineers and executives.

• Comfort working across organisational boundaries in an international, distributed environment.

If you meet most of this and the rest is learnable, we’d still like to hear from you.

Also useful, not required

• Telecom domain knowledge — BSS/OSS, customer operations, order management, digital self-service channels.

• Experience with Azure AI, AWS or Google Cloud AI services.

• Familiarity with AI security, model risk management, observability and evaluation frameworks.

• Experience defining governance that engineering teams adopt willingly.

• Relevant certifications in cloud, AI, data or security.

Practical details

• Location: Teglholmsgade 1, Copenhagen. Hybrid, with four days a week on site.

• Team: You’ll join Data & AI, a team of around 40 people.

• Language: English is our main language of communication. Danish is an advantage.

How to apply

Send your CV and a short note - half a page is plenty - describing one AI use case you’d look at first in a consumer telecom business and why. No formal cover letter needed.

Questions before applying? Contact Sunanda Sengupta at sunse@tdcbrands.dk

**Our Tech Stack: https://stackshare.io/companies/sedna

**About Sedna:

**Sedna is at the forefront of revolutionising the operating system for shipping. Our AI-powered platform is designed to make global trade more efficient, transparent, and sustainable. As we continue to grow and innovate, we are looking for exceptional talent to join our journey and contribute to our mission of transforming the shipping industry .

You can find out more about us on our website: https://sedna.com/

**About the role

**This role focuses on contributing to the design, development, and evolution of Sedna’s VMS (Voyage Management System). It's a mature, highly specialised platform that shipowners, operators and charterers use to run chartering, voyage operations, cargo and freight/hire invoicing.

VMS has a Java backend exposing a REST API used by our own web client (React) and directly by customers' integrations. Data lives in Oracle, including a significant amount of business logic in PL/SQL. It runs on AWS and builds through GitLab CI/CD.

Sedna VMS is in use 24/7 by shipping companies worldwide. Customers run their daily operations and invoicing on it, so correctness, performance and reliability directly affect their business.

You will play a key part in raising standards and delivering new features. You'll take real ownership of features and of how they behave in production, on a product customers run their business on, and help shape how the platform evolves. You'll work with modern AI-assisted development tools as part of everyday engineering.

**How you’ll make an impact

****Engineering and feature development

**This role contributes to both backend and frontend development. Day-to-day responsibilities include understanding requirements, shaping technical approaches, writing code, and contributing to automated tests. Development work spans a mix of new features, improvements, and maintenance, driven by both customer and product needs.

**System architecture and modernisation

**The role includes participating in ongoing efforts to refine and modernise the platform. This involves contributing to technical upgrade work, improving system structure, and supporting longer-term architectural direction as the product grows. Opportunities exist to participate in design discussions and help shape solutions that improve system performance, reliability, and extensibility.

**Quality, testing, and delivery practices

**The team maintains a focus on software quality. We combine unit tests, API regression tests (Postman) and UI tests (Playwright) with peer code review on every merge request. Releases are built and tested through GitLab CI/CD. We're actively improving here: getting more of our test suites running automatically in CI and making them reliable. Engineers who want to drive that, will have room to do it.

**Collaboration with product and customer-facing teams

**The role involves close collaboration with product managers through refinement, planning, and solution discussions. Engineers also interact with Customer Support on cases that need engineering input, and, for larger projects, join customer conversations to validate technical approaches.

**Continuous improvement and documentation

**We treat documentation, including API references, design decisions and runbooks, as part of delivering a change. Much of VMS's knowledge still sits with experienced team members, and capturing it in written, searchable form is an active priority. We also reserve time for technical debt and internal improvements.

**In your first 90 days, you can expect

**

• Month 1: Build your understanding of Sedna’s architecture and our products. Get set up with the VMS codebase, your dev environment and the release process, and ship your first changes. Meet your team, product manager and key customer-facing colleagues. Learn the maritime workflows our customers depend on.

• Month 2: Take ownership of a well-scoped piece of work from refinement with product through to release. Contribute to design discussions, give timely and constructive code review feedback. Shadow the on-call rotation and get familiar with runbooks and production tooling.

• Month 3: Lead the technical approach on a complex feature or improvement within your team, working independently and raising risks and dependencies early. Join the on-call rotation. Contribute improvements to tests, runbooks or documentation based on what you found hard to learn, and support technical validation in a customer conversation where relevant.

**What we're looking for:

****Essential experience

**Candidates typically bring three+ years of professional engineering experience from a comparable environment. Experience working on production systems where quality and reliability are important. Familiarity with a JVM language (Java, Kotlin, Scala) or a similar backend language, React or another modern frontend framework. Strong SQL and relational database skills, ideally Oracle or PostgreSQL, including query performance. Experience supporting production systems: diagnosing incidents from logs and metrics. Prior on-call experience is a plus.

**Critical skills

**A strong grasp of building and maintaining features within a larger system is helpful. Confidence with automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, and code review workflows is expected. Clear thinking, good problem-solving ability, and the capacity to work with domain-heavy logic contribute to success in the role. Experience with enterprise or workflow-driven applications is an advantage.

**Traits and mindset

**Curiosity and a willingness to learn the maritime domain are appreciated. A collaborative working style, comfort sharing ideas in cross-functional settings, and the ability to work independently when needed all support strong performance. Adaptability is important as the product and architecture continue to evolve.

**Core competencies

**Systems thinking, ownership of outcomes, strong communication skills, and effective collaboration are central to this role. A motivation to create value for customers and contribute to a stable, evolving platform is essential.

**What’s In Store for You

**

• A strong team. You’ll join a global team of senior and staff engineers who set a high bar and will help level you up.

• A generous salary and benefits package (depending on experience) + private medical, equity, health and wellbeing benefits, home internet contribution

• Scalability challenges. You’ll be a part of evolving our VMS system as we further develop in to a product led company.

• Customer impact. Real customers use our products everyday, you'll see your work impacting real people.

• Collaboration & autonomy. Plenty of heads-down technical work, but also close partnership with product engineers and engineering leadership.

**Our Values:

**Finally, culture is important to us, so we also look for candidates who share our values:

**Stay Ahead, Stay Agile

**

• We don’t just adapt-we anticipate change and act with confidence.

• Curiosity, data, and customer insights help us stay ahead of the curve.

• We embrace challenges as opportunities and remain resilient under pressure.

• By staying open to new ideas and ways of working, we lead the future.

**Execute With Focus

**

• We turn strategy into action, delivering measurable results that matter.

• Every initiative counts-discipline and ownership drive business impact.

• We make smart decisions with speed, balancing pace and precision.

• Clear priorities keep us focused on what moves the needle.

**Work Together, Win Together

**

• Collaboration is our superpower-we succeed as one team, internally and with customers.

• We co-create solutions, seek feedback, and build the future of Sedna together.

• Strong relationships are built on trust, respect, and shared goals.

• By aligning across teams and with customers, we unlock greater impact.

Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

The Team: Value Engineering is responsible for our largest Fortune 500 customers and owns their transformation journey by working on the very frontier of what’s possible with data and AI on the Celons Platform. Partnering closely with the Sales team, Value Engineering is responsible for ensuring that the Celonis Platform is deployed to tackle the most strategic business challenges, fits into the right place in our customers’ technology stack and most importantly generates strong ROI through deep and broad deployments.

The Role: As a Senior Value Engineer, you will spearhead AI and data-driven business transformation within the Pharmaceutical sector by contributing to your customer’s end-to-end value journey using the Celonis Context Model. Working alongside Lead and Principal VEs, you will combine technical execution with consulting and project management. As an AI-fluent operator, your core mandate is to orchestrate complex roadmaps and execute targeted transformation initiatives that improve how these businesses operate across their ecosystems.

**The work you’ll do:

**

• Value Selling & Realization: Uncover the real issues by peeling back layers of organizational complexity. Own the Outcome from first discovery through realized ROI for your process areas. Tell the Value Story by crafting powerful executive narratives and leading business value workshops.

• Stakeholder Management: Cultivate powerful executive sponsorship across core business units to champion transformation programs. Co-own change management with customer leaders and design CoE roadmaps that build self-sufficiency.

• Program Management: Steer Global Transformations across complex workstreams. Own and implement AI-driven account planning and AI-assisted project management. Automate executive governance (QBRs, SteerCos) with minimal manual friction.

• Platform & AI Fluency: Act as an AI-fluent operator, utilizing AI tools for rapid technical outputs while partnering with Applied Value Engineers for deep-dive solution builds. Champion platform adoption.

• Scale Value & Innovation: Build a strategic expansion roadmap embedding Celonis as a strategic platform to drive adoption. Provide feedback to R&D based on evolving customer use cases.

**The qualifications you need:

**

• Experience: 5+ years of experience taking ownership of complex workstreams, process areas, and customer relationships in Value Engineering, Consulting, or Pre-Sales.

• AI & Technical & Fluency: Solid background in enterprise IT and business software (e.g., SAP, Workday, Salesforce, Oracle). You operate primarily as an AI-fluent operator, utilizing AI copilots to generate outputs and automations, avoiding heavy manual coding.

**What Celonis can offer you:

**

• Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.

• Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated Wellness Weeks that prioritize work/life balance.

• Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.

• Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.

• Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.

**About Us:

The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. By submitting this application, you confirm that you agree to the storing and processing of your personal data by Celonis as described in our Privacy Notice for the Application and Hiring Process.

jobs.occupation: Service Technology and Automation Lead - Global Service
jobs.description:
We are looking for an experienced and commercially minded Service Technology and Automation Lead to modernize our global Customer Service setup. You will drive the implementation of service technology, AI and automation to deliver best-in-class customer experience while improving operational efficiency.

Working closely with Global and Local Service teams, you will optimize processes, develop our global service platform and translate business needs into practical solutions. Your focus will be on increasing efficiency, strengthening service quality and making it easier for customers and partners to do business with us.

**Welcome to Global Sales

**You will join Global Sales, Training and Service within Demant’s Hearing Aids business, where we work to improve the lives of people with hearing loss around the world. We deliver product and sales training, commercial excellence and customer service excellence to our sales companies across Europe, Asia-Pacific, Latin America, the Middle East and Africa, as well as to our independent distributors.

You will become part of our newly established Global Service department, consisting of 14 colleagues. Reporting to the Head of Global Service and joining the Global Service leadership team, you will help define and implement service excellence across our global organization.

**Drive Global Service Efficiency and Automation

**Joining us, you will drive the digitalization of Customer Service through standardized processes, modern technology, AI and automation. You will collaborate with local teams to identify opportunities, develop solutions and ensure successful implementation and adoption.

Success requires a good understanding of Customer Service operations and the ability to use technology to improve efficiency without compromising the personal relationships that underpin great service.

In this role, you will:

• Own and develop Salesforce Service Cloud, including its global rollout, functionality, user experience and roadmap.

• Drive platform adoption and performance, using data and insights to help markets maximize value and identify improvements.

• Implement AI and automation solutions to optimize workflows, improve service quality and increase operational efficiency.

• Define global service standards and guide markets in optimizing technologies such as IVR, workforce management and knowledge repositories.

• Develop customer and partner integrations for larger customers, maintaining the integration roadmap with Global IT.

• Drive stakeholder engagement and implementation, building alignment and momentum across global and local teams.

You can expect approximately 10–20 travel days per year to support our markets and understand local service operations.

**What You Bring

**You hold a relevant commercial master’s degree and ideally have around five years of experience in a similar function, preferably within a larger international organization. You have a track record of improving Customer Service performance and implementing new solutions.

You understand Customer Service at strategic, tactical and operational levels and know how to optimize processes, systems and ways of working. With a good commercial mindset, you recognize how service excellence contributes to customer satisfaction and business performance.

You thrive at the intersection of Customer Service, data, AI and technology. You have experience implementing AI solutions in a business context and translating insights into measurable improvements. Experience with Salesforce Service Cloud, Power BI or similar platforms is an advantage.

As a colleague, you are structured, analytical and collaborative. You can lead projects across organizational boundaries, influence and challenge stakeholders at different levels, and balance global standards with local needs. Your excellent communication and presentation skills enable you to build relationships and create engagement across cultures and functions.

**Come and join us

**This is an opportunity to shape the future of Customer Service across Demant’s global Hearing Aids business. You will work with colleagues and stakeholders across international markets to make our service operations more efficient, scalable and customer-focused through technology, AI and automation.

If you enjoy combining commercial insight, technology and collaboration to create tangible business improvements, we would like to hear from you.

Please submit your CV before the application deadline on November 5.

For inquiries regarding the application process, please use the online application form.

To learn more about the position, contact Steen Busk Marner, Head of Global Service, at skma@demant.com.

We are curious to meet you!

**Recruitment Process Information

**We will begin inviting candidates for interviews after the application deadline. First round of interviews are scheduled for the 12, 13, 16, and 17 of November. You can expect the final round of interviews to be held on the 24 and 25 of November.

We are building the product that enables compliance experts to stay afloat.

• Build AI native software that integrates with the latest models to solve our customers' hardest problems. (we have plenty of tokens)

• Improve the data structures that connects cross border regulatory data

****What we’re looking for

• High agency. You take responsibility and are able to work without a PM giving you tickets

• Experience working at a startup

****What we offer

• Employee friendly equity package

• Competitive salary

• Work at a venture backed startup. Read our latest 11m seed round led by GC here: https://www.complir.io/resources/news/complir-raises-11m-seed

• Assistance with relocation if need be

• 0 -> 1 work. Have real influence on how the product is shaped and work on green field projects

jobs.occupation: Senior Full-Stack Developer – Modern Engineering & Agentic Coding
jobs.description:
If you care about doing full-stack development the right way – through clean architecture, automation, CI/CD, IaC, observability, golden paths, and engineering foundations – you’ll feel right at home at the Tech Collective, where we combine deep technical skills with real client impact.

**What You’ll Do

**Life as a consultant is different from a typical in-house role. At the Tech Collective, consulting means working on a wide range of projects with various clients – so you'll regularly encounter new challenges and have plenty of opportunities to grow your skills quickly.

We believe AI and agentic coding accelerate great developer practices – they do not replace them. That’s why solid architecture, quality, security, maintainability, and sound technical judgement matter more than ever.

In this senior role, you’ll help us understand client needs and turn them into real outcomes by taking technical ownership, guiding teams, and delivering robust solutions from idea to production.

• Build, test, and deliver software using modern engineering practices such as everything-as-code, CI/CD, GitOps, automation, and open-source principles

• Act as a trusted advisor to clients, helping them make great decisions and turn ideas into practical solutions

• Work across frontend and backend technologies, taking part in architectural decisions, system design, containerised environments, and clear, maintainable documentation

• Improve developer and user experience by shifting quality left, applying strong design principles, mentoring others, and delivering minimum viable products with a clear path to scale

• Design, build, and operate platforms and infrastructure, including APIs, CLIs, platform engineering, immutable infrastructure, and internal developer platforms

• Collaborate, teach, and lead through effective communication, technical writing, code reviews, lean principles, and strong data and security practices

• Lead technical workstreams and collaborate closely with clients, translating business needs into pragmatic technical solutions

**What You’ll Bring

**One thing that can be said of all your future colleagues is that we’re curious by nature, have a team-first mindset, a good sense of humour, and clear opinions on how tech can create value for our clients. If this sounds like you, you’ll be a great fit at The Tech Collective.

We’re looking for people with a relevant M.Sc. (this is mandatory and could be, for example, in computer science or software engineering) who are based within commuting distance of our office in Copenhagen.

**We’re looking for someone with a minimum of 5 years of professional experience in full-stack software development or similar engineering roles.

**On top of that, the ideal candidate is someone who brings senior engineering experience and:

• Communicates clearly in both written and spoken English

• Shares our values around software quality and delivery

• Enjoys working closely with clients and building trusted relationships with them

• Is tool-agnostic and chooses the right tool for the job

• Is comfortable with complexity and able to break problems down into manageable pieces

• Has solid experience building and operating modern software systems in production

• Understands software architecture, system design, testing, security, and maintainability

• Can guide technical decisions, challenge assumptions, and communicate trade-offs clearly

• Has experience mentoring or supporting other developers through code reviews, pairing, or technical sparring

Please note that you don’t need to meet all the criteria. The most important thing is that you have an engineering foundation, a senior mindset, consulting skills and curiosity to keep learning and growing.

**What We Offer

**When you step into our office, you step into a world of nerdery – and we love it and intend to keep it that way. You’ll become part of a low-ego, high-trust team of sharp engineers who you’ll work closely with from day one.

**Working With Us Means

**

• Real autonomy, real impact: you’ll own features end to end and lean into the tech you care most about.

• Growth that matters: a learning programme, mentoring, and plenty of peer knowledge sharing.

• Community and craft: strategy trips, meetups, and events across The Tech Collective/Implement Consulting Group.

Ready to shape the digital future with us? Let us know why and how in your cover letter and apply ASAP.

We’re on holiday during July, so please expect slightly longer response times.

Senior Research DSP Engineer

Location: Snekkersten.

Are you an experienced DSP Engineer ready to broaden your technical scope and help shape the hearing solutions of the future?

At Eriksholm Research Centre, we are looking for a technically strong and practically minded Senior Research DSP Engineer to join our scientific team. You will help mature promising research ideas into robust concepts, demonstrators, and technical solutions that can move closer to adoption by R&D.

About the position

Eriksholm generates scientific insights and explores new technologies with the potential to improve future hearing care. We work closely with scientists, engineers, and Oticon R&D to ensure that promising ideas can be translated into solutions with meaningful impact for people with hearing loss.

In this position, you will bridge scientific exploration and engineering implementation. You will combine strong digital signal processing and acoustics expertise with hands-on experimental work, modelling, and prototype development.

You will collaborate closely with scientists and development specialists, helping teams assess technical feasibility, build convincing demonstrations, and mature early-stage concepts for further development.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Developing and evaluating audio and DSP concepts for hearing aids.

• Translating scientific ideas into working algorithms, prototypes, and demonstrators.

• Designing acoustic measurements and experimental laboratory setups.

• Building models and tools for analysing and validating technical concepts.

• Supporting the maturation and technical transfer of promising research solutions towards R&D.

• Contributing to the development and maintenance of research hearing-aid platforms and laboratory capabilities.

• Providing technical support across scientific projects involving areas such as own-voice processing, acoustic perception, and data-driven signal processing.

• Taking responsibility for selected laboratory equipment, methods, and workflows.

The ideal candidate

You are curious, analytical, and motivated by solving complex technical problems. You enjoy moving between theory, modelling, implementation, and hands-on laboratory work. You are comfortable working with early-stage ideas where the path forward is not always fully defined.

You take ownership of your work, communicate technical topics clearly, and collaborate well with colleagues from different scientific and engineering disciplines. You also understand the importance of balancing scientific ambition with the practical requirements needed to bring a concept closer to product development.

We expect that you have:

• A master’s degree in electrical engineering, acoustical engineering, signal processing, or a related technical discipline.

• Several years of relevant experience in hearing-aid development, audio technology, or another technically related area. Experience from product development, research, technology exploration, or advanced engineering would all provide a strong foundation for this role.

• Strong knowledge of digital signal processing and acoustics.

• Experience with acoustic measurements, laboratory setups, modelling, and technical validation.

• Experience developing and evaluating algorithms in environments such as MATLAB, Python, or similar tools.

• The ability to translate complex technical challenges into structured experiments and practical solutions.

• Strong collaboration and communication skills.

• Professional proficiency in English.

Your workplace

The position is based on our site in Snekkersten, where you will work closely with Eriksholm’s multidisciplinary scientific community.

Eriksholm Research Centre is part of Oticon’s R&D organization. We pursue audiological discoveries with the potential to enhance customer and end-user benefits in future hearing care and work to ensure that scientific insights can be applied in solutions supporting people with hearing loss.

We are a multicultural and multidisciplinary team that values scientific integrity, collaboration, mutual respect, and openness. Our informal environment provides room to explore new ideas, challenge assumptions, and take considered technical risks.

Do you want to join Eriksholm Research Centre? Interested in our exciting position? - Deadline is the 22nd of November 2026.

Electro-Acoustic Engineer

Denmark

Smørum

Electro Acoustic Development Engineer

If electro acoustic development of hearing instruments throughout the spectra form concept to finial product seems interesting, and if having fun at work makes you smile, then read on! We may just have the job for you.

In the Device Hardware area, we are looking for an Electro Acoustic engineer to expand our team. You will work with product development using cutting-edge tools in well-equipped modern facilities with the goal of developing the best hardware for our hearing instruments.

Join the Hardware development team

As an electro acoustic developer, you would be part of an agile development team with responsibility for design and verification of the electroacoustic concepts. We focus on delivering solutions that enable us to deliver high-quality hearing instrument solutions, including in-depth transducer knowledge and development of new acoustic concepts for future products. We are depending on, and facilitating, in-depth knowledge about vibroacoustic behavior of subsystems and complete hearing aid solutions.

We participate in product development as well as maturation of concepts, before they are used in product development. Sometimes we participate in after launch activities as well.

Building, documenting and sharing knowledge is key to our success. Communication of key findings and results gained in is cross functional cooperation with mechanical and electronics developers in our Agile Release Trains are sessional.

Building innovative Electro Acoustic Solutions

In collaboration with skilled team members within your own Agile Release Train, you will work to innovate electro acoustic and mechanical solutions that elevate the experience of both end-users and customers. The excitement this group faces daily is the development of highly complex platforms, due to the high degree of functionality that hearing instruments offer. Furthermore, we focus on developing our platforms to fit multiple brands, adding to the complexity. The team works closely together with other professionals, i.e., audiologists and engineers specializing in amplifiers and embedded systems.

The biggest hardware challenge is to develop a platform that provides the needed acoustical gain and at the same time securing a good mechanical and acoustic feedback margin. Here a close cooperation with the mechanical engineers and the pre-production team is crucial for a good result.

You will be involved in:

• Acoustic systemdesign and Development

• Platform calibration/settings

• Design specifications

• Selection of components i.e. transducers – microphones, receivers/speakers

• Testing, verifying and documenting electro-acoustical performance of HW platforms

• Effort estimation and planning done in an agile framework

In the role of Electro Acoustic Developer, you will collaborate with skilled team members to advance the design of next-generation cutting-edge hearing instruments.

Apart from working together with motivated colleagues you will experience that we have great focus on your skills development, the department’s professional skills and in Work-life balance.

You can expect 1-5 travel days a year, visiting suppliers and our production site in Poland.

Qualifications

We expect you to hold a degree in Engineering, focusing specifically on electro acoustics. We anticipate that you possess strong qualifications in Sound Quality, Acoustic measurements, vibro-acoustics, and sound path design. Knowledge from working with electro acoustic or magnetic designs of hearing instruments or other smaller products such as cell phones, headsets or similar is an advantage.

You perform best in a vibrant atmosphere and enjoy partnering with experienced coworkers to make the most of your skills. We offer further development opportunities and believe Oticon is a good place to develop your career further.

As a person, you are proud of your profession, curious and a team player by heart. You have good communication skills and enjoy networking and navigating in a delivery driven, cross-functional organization with several parallel development tracs.

Apply

jobs.occupation: Head of Europe Financial Control and Governance
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about? Do you have experience within financial control and governance?

If so, now is your chance to join Ascendis Pharma as our new Head of Europe financial control and governance.

Ascendis Pharma is a global biopharmaceutical company committed to making a meaningful difference in patients' lives. Guided by our core values of Patients, Science, and Passion, we are applying our innovative TransCon® technology platform to fulfill our mission of developing new therapies that demonstrate best-in-class potential to address unmet medical needs.

At our headquarters in Hellerup, Denmark, research facilities in Heidelberg, Germany, and additional offices across Europe and the United States, we are advancing programs in our Endocrinology Rare Disease and Oncology portfolios. We also collaborate with partners on the development of TransCon-based products in other therapeutic areas and markets.

We are seeking a passionate Head of Europe financial control and governance to join our growing team. As a key member of the Ascendis Pharma team, you will play a crucial role in Europe regional oversight, assurance and coordination across European entities. This is an exciting opportunity to work in a fast-paced environment, collaborate with cross-functional, global teams working together to achieve extraordinary results.

You will be joining the finance operations team consisting of 33 colleagues, and report directly to Cicek Wrabetz, Head of Europe Finance Operations who is based in Munich, Germany. You will be based in Hellerup, Denmark.

Your key responsibilities will be:

• Lead regional governance and assurance. Maintain oversight of material accounting, reporting, control and compliance matters across Europe. Identify gaps, clarify ownership and coordinate resolution across teams and countries

• Oversee financial reporting and accounting. Coordinate statutory reporting and external audits across European jurisdictions and provide assurance over close, financial reporting and internal controls

• Navigate local requirements. Bring structure to country-specific requirements, including withholding tax, statutory obligations and invoicing, working closely with Tax, Legal, Compliance, Treasury and relevant process owners

• Drive launch and change readiness. Represent the European financial-control and governance perspective in new-market and entity launches, identifying local requirements and impacts across processes, systems, data and controls

• Simplify and strengthen ways of working. Challenge unnecessary complexity, country variations and manual workarounds. Identify root causes, clarify ownership and help implement compliant, scalable and sustainable solutions

• Leverage technology, AI and automation. Partner with Finance Systems and process owners to translate business needs and pain points into well-defined, controllable and scalable solutions, using technology where it creates meaningful value

Qualifications and Skills:

You hold a relevant academic degree - preferably a MBA or Bachelor of Management /Economics/ business administration or equivalent - and 10+ years of experience including meaningful responsibility for accounting, financial operations, monthly close, managing external accountants, auditors and controls.

Furthermore, you have:

• 5+ years of experience within external or internal audit, controllership, financial control, Finance Operations, transformation, or a related field in an international environment

• Strong knowledge of accounting, IFRS, internal controls, audit, and European statutory and regulatory requirements

• A professional qualification such as CPA, Cand.merc.aud., ACCA, Wirtschaftsprüfer, or equivalent is preferred

• Demonstrated experience in strengthening controls, redesigning processes, and simplifying ways of working

• Experience working across countries and functions, including O2C, P2P, R2R, Tax, Treasury, Legal, Compliance, and Finance Systems

• Interest in and hands-on experience with ERP systems, analytics, automation, AI, or digital finance initiatives. Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 is an advantage

Key competencies:

You are a strong team player, analytical, and have a can-do attitude.

You possess an entrepreneurial mindset and can thrive in an informal, open environment where innovation and change are key.

To succeed in this role, we also expect you to

• Challenge complexity and has evidence of making processes simpler, stronger or more scalable

• Collaborate across functions and geographies and influences without relying on formal authority

• Balance control, compliance, business needs and practical implementation

Travel: 10-20 days per year.

Office: Ascendis Pharma A/S Tuborg Boulevard 12, 2900 Hellerup, Denmark

Apply now.

We evaluate applications when received, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. Please note that we conduct interviews on a rolling basis and reserve the right to remove the job posting at any time.

jobs.occupation: Kvalitetssikringsmedarbejder søges til Firesafe Danmark A/S
jobs.description:
Kvalitetssikringsmedarbejder søges til Firesafe Danmark A/S

Har du øje for kvalitet, teknisk forståelse og lyst til at arbejde tæt på byggeprocessen?

Hos Firesafe Danmark A/S søger vi to kvalitetssikringsmedarbejdere til at styrke vores kvalitetssikring inden for passiv brandsikring og isolering. Vi søger strukturerede og kvalitetsbevidste medarbejdere med teknisk forståelse.

Du får en varieret hverdag, hvor du kombinerer praktiske kvalitetstilsyn på byggepladsen med teknisk opfølgning og dokumentation. Du kommer til at arbejde tæt sammen med montører, projektledere og øvrige kolleger.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

·         Udføre løbende kvalitetstilsyn og kontrol af passiv brandsikring og isoleringsarbejde.

·         Kontrollere, at arbejdet udføres i overensstemmelse med tekniske tegninger, montagevejledninger og gældende krav.

·         Identificere kvalitetsafvigelser og følge op på nødvendige udbedringer.

·         Udarbejde og vedligeholde kvalitetsdokumentation samt registrere og følge op på opgaver i Dalux og BIM.

·         Vejlede montører i korrekte arbejdsmetoder og tekniske løsninger, herunder demonstrere korrekt udførelse.

·         Samarbejde med ledelsen om tekniske afklaringer, koordinering og kvalitetsopfølgning.

Vi forventer, at du:

•         Har teknisk forståelse og interesse for kvalitetssikring.

•         Kan læse og forstå bygningstegninger og teknisk dokumentation.

•         Arbejder selvstændigt, systematisk og følger dine opgaver til dørs.

•         Kan kommunikere på dansk eller engelsk, både mundtligt og skriftligt.

•         Er fortrolig med digitale værktøjer og har lyst til at arbejde med kvalitetsdokumentation.

•         Kan vejlede montører og følge op på kvaliteten af det udførte arbejde.

Det er en fordel, hvis du har:

•         Erfaring med kvalitetssikring og kontrol i byggebranchen.

•         Kendskab til passiv brandsikring, isolering eller lignende teknisk arbejde.

•         Erfaring med Dalux og BIM.

•         Gode danskkundskaber og kendskab til flere sprog.

Der stilles ikke krav om en bestemt uddannelse, dog er det en fordele hvis man har en teknisk baggrund. 

Vi tilbyder

•         Fast fuldtidsstilling på minimum 37 timer om ugen.

•         Tiltrædelse hurtigst muligt eller efter aftale.

•         Løn efter kvalifikationer og erfaring samt pension og øvrige vilkår i henhold til gældende overenskomst.

•         Firmatelefon, computer og andet relevant udstyr i forbindelse med arbejdet.

•         En varieret arbejdsdag med både praktiske og administrative opgaver.

•         Et arbejdsmiljø med gode kolleger og mulighed for faglig udvikling.

Om Firesafe Danmark A/S

Firesafe Danmark A/S arbejder med passiv brandsikring og relaterede tekniske ydelser på byggeprojekter. Vi bidrager til at beskytte mennesker, bygninger og værdier gennem korrekt udførelse og dokumentation af brandtekniske løsninger.

Hos os bliver du en del af en organisation, hvor kvalitet, samarbejde og ansvarlighed er i fokus.

Ansøgning

Lyder stillingen som noget for dig?

Send dit CV og en kort beskrivelse af din motivation for at søge jobbet til info@firesafe.dk

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Søren Christiansen soeren.christiansen@firesafe.dk

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

 

  

Quality Assurance Employee Wanted at Firesafe Danmark A/S

Do you have an eye for detail, a strong technical understanding, and a passion for ensuring high quality workmanship on construction sites?

Firesafe Danmark A/S is looking to recruit two Quality Assurance Employees to strengthen our quality assurance team within passive fire protection and insulation works.

In this role, you will combine on-site quality inspections with technical follow-up and documentation. You will work closely with installers, project managers, and other members of the project team to ensure that installations meet the required quality standards.

Key Responsibilities

•         Conduct regular QA/QC inspections of passive fire protection and insulation works on-site.

•         Verify that installations comply with approved drawings, installation instructions, project specifications, and applicable requirements.

•         Identify non-conformities and follow up on corrective actions to ensure proper close-out.

•         Prepare and maintain quality documentation, inspection records, and reports, including the registration and follow-up of quality-related issues in Dalux and BIM models.

•         Provide technical guidance to installers on approved installation methods and demonstrate correct workmanship when required.

•         Coordinate with the project team regarding technical clarifications, site activities, and quality-related matters.

About You

We are looking for a responsible, structured, and solution-oriented individual with strong attention to detail. You are comfortable working both on construction sites and in a site office, and you can communicate effectively with different trades and project stakeholders.

We expect you to:

•         Have a good technical understanding and a strong interest in quality assurance and quality control.

•         Be able to read and interpret construction drawings and technical documentation.

•         Work independently, systematically, and take ownership of your tasks.

•         Communicate effectively in English or Danish, both verbally and in writing.

•         Be comfortable using digital tools for inspections and quality documentation.

•         Be confident in guiding installers and following up on the quality of completed work.

 

It would be an advantage if you have:

•         Previous experience in QA/QC, quality inspections, or construction site supervision.

•         Knowledge of passive fire protection, insulation, or similar construction activities.

•         Experience working with Dalux and BIM.

•         Hands-on construction site experience, including providing technical guidance to installers.

•         Good Danish language skills and knowledge of additional languages.

A specific educational background is not required. We value relevant practical experience, technical understanding, and the right attitude.

What We Offer

•         A permanent, full-time position with a minimum of 37 working hours per week.

•         Start date as soon as possible or by agreement.

•         Competitive salary based on qualifications and experience, including pension and other employment benefits in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and employment contract.

•         Company phone and the possibility of a company vehicle, depending on project requirements.

•         A varied workday combining on-site inspections with office-based QA/QC activities.

•         A supportive and informal working environment with opportunities for professional development.

About Firesafe Danmark A/S

Firesafe Danmark A/S specialises in passive fire protection and related technical services within the construction industry.

Our work contributes to protecting people, buildings, and assets by ensuring that fire protection systems are correctly installed, inspected, and documented in accordance with project specifications and applicable requirements.

You will become part of a team where quality, teamwork, and accountability are at the core of our daily operations.

How to Apply

Interested in joining our team?

Please submit your CV along with a short description of your motivation for applying to info@firesafe.dk

If you have any questions about the position, feel free to contact Søren Christiansen soeren.christiansen@firesafe.dk for further information.

We look forward to hearing from you!
